messages:
deploy-bot: roll v2026.03.21-gn2 deployed to prod-us (canary->100%). Running post-deploy smoke: prefix-cache-health + synth-convo + kv-warmup.
Jia: prefix-cache probe in us-east-1 shows p95 increased from 210ms -> 760ms ~90s after roll. Errors=0 but request tail plenty.
Jia: probe data:
```
region=us-east-1
probe=prefix-cache
keys_sample=2000
p50=130ms
p95=760ms
p99=1400ms
miss_rate=0.12
observed_cache_evictions spiked around ts 1812345690
```
Tomas: kernel scheduling change in this release added a longer window for KV warming to batch prefill. Could be causing eviction churn under steady traffic.
Jia: can we run a quick config rollback for prefix-cache warmup timer in us-east-1 to previous value (warmup_ms=300 -> 50)? If that drops evictions we can then re-enable with smaller step.
Tomas: +1. @deploy-bot apply-config region=us-east-1 service=prefix-cache warmup_ms=50 reason="postdeploy-eviction-spike"
deploy-bot: applying config...
deploy-bot: config applied (region=us-east-1 service=prefix-cache warmup_ms=50) at ts=1812345710.
ops-bot: running quick-check after config change...
ops-bot: prefix-cache p95 back to 220ms within ~20s, miss_rate 0.03. eviction-rate normalized.
oncall-bot: overall probes: synth-convo and kv-warmup unaffected. No 5xx or throttles.
Jia: created ticket INF-5340 for follow-up to tune batching window + add alert for eviction-rate >0.05. Will attach flamegraphs and cache metrics.
Tomas: I'll reproduce on staging with traffic replay and iterate warmup heuristics, planning a gradual rollout if fixed.
Jia: marking region-pinned us-east-1 until behavioral change confirmed. Noting release notes update and support ping. :spiral_note_pad:
deploy-bot: summary: post-deploy eviction spike observed in prefix-cache in us-east-1; temporary warmup_ms rollback applied -> immediate recovery. Follow-ups: INF-5340, staging perf replay. Thread will remain open for final verification.
